mission: Mara in a Toryaz corridor; Lumiya's tasseled hem glimpsed; Mara registers the hem without identifying Lumiya.
why_now: Mara is walking between sessions when Lumiya passes.
opening_hook: Mara walking a Toryaz residential corridor toward her quarters.
conflict: Mara's operational reading of the figure vs. the figure's disappearance before Mara's read completes.
turning_point: Mara registers the hem as wrong but does not yet name why — the moment she will replay after the bombing.
closing_hook: Mara reaching her quarters; the hem already out of the frame.
sensory_details: Station lighting; corridor's dull carpet; the tasseled hem in peripheral vision.
emotional_trajectory: Routine transit → peripheral unease → filed-away note.

stakes.interpersonal: The Mara/Tresina friendship that depends on Mara's vigilance.

notes: The tassels sighting the reader will remember after Ch 19.
